note: Updates beat: look at what's actually wrong, try a restart, call IT. Ends map to v1 ids: updates-ignore, updates-restart, updates-report.

warn.say: The loaner at hot desk 14-08. In the corner: Device Health. Updates failed, 23 days. Harbor Shield agent: off. The dock log is due in ten minutes.

restarted.say: It restarts. Two minutes later, the same warning is back. Shield is still off.

it.say: Thanks for calling. That loaner hasn't checked in for weeks, so don't use it for anything sensitive. I've opened a ticket and I'm pushing a fix now. Use desk 14-11 for the dock log tonight.

look_updates.label: Open Windows Update
look_updates.look: Last successful update: 23 days ago. Three security updates failed to install.

look_shield.label: Look at the Shield icon
look_shield.look: The Harbor Shield icon in the tray is grey. Hover: "Protection off. Contact IT." You didn't turn it off.

look_badge.label: Check your badge
look_badge.look: On the back of your badge: IT help desk, ext 4100.

ignore.label: Dismiss it and start the dock log

tells.why: Three security updates have failed for 23 days. That laptop is missing weeks of fixes.
The security agent is off and you didn't turn it off. Something, or someone, did.
You called the number on your badge. You don't have to fix it, just tell IT.

headlines.updates-restart: You tried a restart, then kept working on it.
